|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Antilles Maneuver (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-antillesmaneuver022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/antillesmaneuver.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/antillesmaneuver.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Antilles Maneuver (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-antillesmaneuverab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/antillesmaneuver.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/antillesmaneuver.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
